scope: Runtime selection, native Canvas pixels, controlled DOM. No new final sprite artwork.

checks.name: All 346 combat identities resolve both requested directions without mutation
Attack direction takes precedence over screen crossing and actor velocity
Engine owns idle facing; retreating does not turn the sprite away from the opponent
Presentation-only actors face their counterpart and retain direction at identical positions
Front-facing portraits are never labelled as lateral and are not squashed
Independent side files are selected with no second flip and with their own foot anchors
A single lateral pose cannot be mirrored without a per-drawing review
Asymmetric anatomy rejects reflection even when a malformed registry requests it
Unreviewed, frontal or mismatched directional images cannot pass the runtime contract
All gameplay renderer pages load the same direction contract before drawing
Native Canvas draws independent directional texture pixels, not an illustrative screenshot
Portrait path is preserved independently of directional combat selection
Production registry does not pretend that undelivered artwork exists
In-game direction inspection initializes the actual shared rendering code
